Trap: the usual workaround, a CLAUDE.md holding only `@AGENTS.md`, at the root and in packages/api; packages/web has an AGENTS.md and no CLAUDE.md. Launched at the root, the root CLAUDE.md switches AGENTS.md off, so packages/web/AGENTS.md never reaches Claude Code (rule claude.agents-default). The two imported AGENTS.md files do arrive, the package's on read, and neither CLAUDE.md names AGENTS.md without importing it (rule claude.words). map used to report both CLAUDE.md files as claude.words-not-import once any AGENTS.md was switched off, and, before that, packages/api/AGENTS.md as shadowed too (the study's known-answer fixture census-o2-external-import).
